integrity: The universal theorem is established analytically. Finite computations corroborate rather than prove the identities. No independent external validation or priority certification has been performed.
limitations: Three independent arclength-uniform samples on a fixed geodesic circle in the unit sphere; intrinsic acute geodesic angles only. Radius strictly between zero and pi/2. No cap-interior, entire-sphere, Euclidean chord, or arbitrary-surface extension. The broad older literature is not exhaustively accessible.
title: Exact two-transition acuteness law for triangles inscribed in spherical small circles
